fields.definition: ACCIDENT_NO is the Primary Key for the database to uniquely identify the accident and cannot contain NULL values. First character T indicates TIS incident and characters 2-5 typically represent the year in which the accident created in TIS system and characters 6-11 are a numeric sequencing number.
fields.name: Accident Number

fields.definition: VEHCILE_ID is a character field that uniquely identifies each vehicle involved in the accident. Vehicles have a letter value assigned to them. This field cannot contain NULL values.
fields.name: Vehicle ID

fields.definition: VEHICLE_YEAR_MANUF is an integer field indicates the year in which the vehicle was built or manufactured. The data is stored in yyyy format.
fields.name: Vehicle Year of Manufacture

fields.definition: VEHICLE_DCA_CODE is a character field indicates that links the vehicle with the movement depicted in the DCA table. For example, if the DCA code for the accident is 111 and the vehicle DCA code is 2, then an inspection of the DCA chart will show that the second vehicle involved in the accident was turning right.
fields.fixed_values: Code Description 1 Vehicle 1 2 Vehicle 2 3 Not known which vehicle was number 1 8 Not involved in initial event
fields.name: Vehicle DCA Code

fields.definition: INTIAL_DIRECTION is a character field indicates the initial or first direction of travel of the vehicle. For a vehicle that is turning, the initial direction will be different to the final direction. For a non-turning vehicle, the initial direction will be the same as the final direction.
fields.fixed_values: Code Description E East N North NE North east NW North west S South SE South east SW South west W West NK Not known
fields.name: Initial Direction

fields.definition: Road surface type describes the type of road surface the crash occurred on (e.g. paved, unpaved, gravel etc)
fields.fixed_values: Code Description 1 Paved 2 Unpaved 3 Gravel 9 Not known
fields.name: Road Surface Type

fields.definition: Road surface type its a descriptive field that describes the type of road surface the crash occurred on (e.g. paved, unpaved, gravel etc)
fields.fixed_values: Code Description 1 Paved 2 Unpaved 3 Gravel 9 Not known
fields.name: Road Surface Type Description

sources.coverage: Current portal starts 2012; each resource has its own reporting period and refresh date.
sources.revision: Monthly, approximately seven-month lag; provisional fatal records can be changed or removed.
limitations: Legacy DataVic API returned 404; current Transport Victoria package has a different UUID.
Accident/person/vehicle and flat lite export overlap: do not double count.
Current public schema does not remove restrictions on the project’s frozen VIC profile.
Dictionary labels differ from CSV headers; sample evidence required before alias binding.
Seven ancillary tables are separate grains; not all fit current canonical-v2 one-crash-table model.

info.label: Crash Reference Number
info.notes: Unique identifier for each crash incident. Deidentified and may not be persistent between releases. First 4 digits currently identify the year of the crash

info.label: Crash Severity
info.notes: Crash severity is categorised into five levels: Fatal, Hospitalisation, Medical Treatment, Minor Injury and Property damage only. It is based on the maximum severity of all units involved in the crash.

info.label: Crash Year
info.notes: Year in which the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Month
info.notes: Month in which the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Day Of Week
info.notes: Day of the week when the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Hour
info.notes: Hour (0 to 23) during which the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Nature
info.notes: Nature of the initial event (Head-on, hit pedestrian, and so on)

info.label: Crash Type
info.notes: Logical grouping of crash natures.

info.label: Crash Longitude
info.notes: Longitude coordinate where the crash occurred (GDA2020)

info.label: Crash Latitude
info.notes: Latitude coordinate where the crash occurred (GDA2020)

info.label: Crash Street
info.notes: Name of the street where the initial crash event occurred.

info.label: Crash Street Intersecting
info.notes: Name of the first alphabetically listed intersecting street where the crash occurred (if applicable)

info.label: State Road Name
info.notes: State-controlled road name of the street where the crash occurred. (Name may differ from any local road name applied to the road section)

info.label: Location Suburb
info.notes: Suburb where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Local Government Area
info.notes: Local government area where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Post Code
info.notes: Postal code where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Police Division
info.notes: Queensland Police Service (QPS) division where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Police District
info.notes: Queensland Police Service (QPS) district where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Police Region
info.notes: Queensland Police Service (QPS) region where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Queensland Transport Region
info.notes: Department of Transport and Main Roads (DTMR) Customer Services Branch (CSB) region where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Main Roads Region
info.notes: Department of Transport and Main Roads (DTMR) Program Deliver and Operations (PDO) region where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location ABS Statistical Area 2
info.notes: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2) where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location ABS Statistical Area 3
info.notes: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Statistical Area Level 3 (SA3) where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location ABS Statistical Area 4
info.notes: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4) where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location ABS Remoteness
info.notes: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Remoteness classification where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location State Electorate
info.notes: State electoral division where the crash occurred.

info.label: Location Federal Electorate
info.notes: Federal electoral division where the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Controlling Authority
info.notes: The level of government responsible for maintenance and administration of the road where the crash occurred.

info.label: Crash Roadway Feature
info.notes: Features of the roadway where the crash occurred (e.g., bridge, intersection, median etc.).

info.label: Crash Traffic Control
info.notes: The method used (if any) to direct traffic at the time and location of the crash.

info.label: Crash Speed Limit
info.notes: Speed limit where the crash occurred. (km/h)

info.label: Crash Road Surface Condition
info.notes: Condition of the road surface at the time of the crash (e.g., sealed, unsealed, sealed-wet etc.).

info.label: Crash Atmospheric Condition
info.notes: Weather conditions at the time of the crash (e.g., fog, dust, rain, hail etc.).

info.label: Crash Lighting Condition
info.notes: Lighting conditions at the time of the crash (e.g., daylight, darkness, dawn/dusk etc.).

info.label: Crash Road Horizontal Alignment
info.notes: Horizontal alignment of the road (e.g., straight, curved etc.).

info.label: Crash Road Vertical Alignment
info.notes: Vertical alignment of the road (e.g., level, crest, grade, dip).

info.label: Crash DCA Code
info.notes: DCA describes the movement and actions of the units involved in the crash [ARRB Technical Manual ATM 29 (Andreassen, 1991 and Andreassen, 1992)], DCA stands for "Definition for Coding Accident"

info.label: Crash DCA Description
info.notes: The definition of the crash that matches the DCA code

info.label: Crash DCA Group Description
info.notes: A grouping of similar crash definitions based on their DCA coding

info.label: DCA Key Approach Direction
info.notes: Compass direction defining the movement of the Key Unit in a crash for DCA coding.

info.label: Count Casualty Fatality
info.notes: The number of fatalities for all road users involved in a crash.  This includes any road users that died within 30 days of the crash as a result of injuries received in the crash.

info.label: Count Casualty Hospitalised
info.notes: The total number of human road users that were sent to Hospital from a crash.

info.label: Count Casualty Medically Treated
info.notes: The number of road users that received medical treatment as a result of the crash.

info.label: Count Casualty Minor Injury
info.notes: The number of road users who received minor injuries as a result of the crash.

info.label: Count Casualty Total
info.notes: The number of road users that were either killed or injured as a result of the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Car
info.notes: Number of cars\utilities involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Motorcycle Moped
info.notes: Number of motorcycle\mopeds involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Truck
info.notes: Number of trucks involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Bus
info.notes: Number of buses involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Bicycle
info.notes: Number of bicycles involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Pedestrian
info.notes: Number of pedestrians involved in the crash.

info.label: Count Unit Other
info.notes: Number of other types of vehicles involved in the crash. (This can include animals under human control, trains and so on)
